defect: held data bus bypasses bit synchronizers under a closed handshake
rationale: The producer holds payload until a synchronized acknowledgement returns; the receiver samples after two request stages plus a further cycle. The payload settling bound is explicit.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.by: claude-opus-5-5 (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Toggle req/ack handshake with both directions double-synchronised; held is stable while req != ack, and the datapath max_delay bounds the payload path.
